movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

movelist.name: Flame Charge
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: Charge
movelist.effect: If the user performs an Electric Move on their next turn that deals damage, add its Damage Dice Roll an extra time to the damage. Raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.trigger: A ranged Electric Type Move is used within 10
abilities.effect: The Move is turned into a 1-Target Move and is re-directed at the user without fail, and cannot miss. This negates Lock-On or Mind Reader.  The user’s Special Attack is then raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.trigger: The user uses the Sprint Action during Combat
abilities.effect: The user gains +2 Speed Combat Stages.
